text: One technique used for studying antigen-antibody reactions is immunodiffusion.
Wells are cut into an agar support medium to contain antigens and antibodies. Antibodies
and antigens diffuse out of the wells into the agar. If an antigen meets a complementary
antibody a reaction occurs causing a band of precipitate to appear.
